notes: A bin for what you delete

entries.title: A bin for what you delete
entries.detail: Deleted notebooks, sections and pages now wait 30 days in the bin before they are gone for good. Open it with Bin at the foot of the notebook list: each item says where it was and how many days it has left, and Restore puts it back. A deleted notebook can also be brought back with Undo.

entries.title: Your name in task lines, for j4k
entries.detail: Settings › j4k has a field for the name your task lines give you, such as "First Last". Tasks given to that name go to j4k. Left empty, folia takes your account's name, as before. After a change, the tasks of your pages go again within three minutes.

entries.title: Bigger text in pages and lists
entries.detail: The text of a page and the rows of the notebook, section and page lists are a little bigger, 14.5 instead of 13.5 pixels. Headings grow with the text. Code blocks and formulas have the same rounded corners as the rest.

entries.title: The red Delete button reads well in dark mode
entries.detail: In dark mode the word on a red Delete button is dark now. White on that light red was hard to read.

entries.title: One text size, easier to read
entries.detail: A question's text and its buttons now have the size of the text around them, not a larger one. Links, chosen rows and the keyboard ring are a little darker in light mode, so they read better. A notebook's letter is dark on the light colours. Small labels, titles and corners all follow one scale.

entries.title: Docs in Settings opens the manual in a window
entries.detail: In the folia Mac app, Settings › About folia › Docs opens the folia Field Manual in a window of the app, as the Docs button in the About folia window does. In a browser it still opens the page online.

entries.title: A wider search bar
entries.detail: The search bar in the top bar is up to twice as wide, and its list of pages found is as wide as the bar. In a narrow window it stays smaller, so the tools still fit.

entries.title: Tasks go to j4k from every page, once you stop typing
entries.detail: Tasks to j4k now takes the Tasks of every page you make after switching it on, not only meeting pages. A page's tasks go once it has had no change for two minutes, so a task you are still typing never arrives half-written.

entries.title: The j4k switch waits until it knows
entries.detail: Settings › j4k › Tasks to j4k is greyed out for a moment while folia reads whether it is on. Before, it showed off and then jumped to on, which looked as if opening the part switched it on. The setting itself was always kept.

entries.title: Your meeting tasks go to j4k, and come back ticked
entries.detail: Settings › j4k › Tasks to j4k: your tasks and tasks given to nobody, from the Tasks of a meeting's page, go to Review in j4k. When you set one to Done in j4k, folia ticks it in the page within two minutes. It works for meetings that start after you switch it on, also when folia is not open. scripta no longer sends tasks to j4k itself.

entries.title: The meetings panel keeps its arrows, and has Today
entries.detail: In the meetings panel, only the meetings scroll: the week arrows stay at the top. Today, left of the arrows, goes back to today's meetings.

entries.title: The … menus in groups
entries.detail: A page's … menu shows its entries in groups with a small heading: Open, Copy, Move and Page group, with Delete apart at the end. The menus of notebooks and sections are grouped the same way: New, On this Mac, Colour.

entries.title: About folia has Settings…
entries.detail: About folia now has the buttons every app of the family has, in the same order: Docs, What's New… and Settings…, which opens folia's Settings the way the menu does.

entries.title: Split view: two pages side by side or one above the other
entries.detail: Drag a page from the page list onto the page: near an edge it opens beside it, on that side; in the middle it takes its place. ⌥-click a page, a search result or a [[link]], or choose Open in split view in a page's … menu, to open it in the other pane. Click a pane to work in it: the page list, Outline, History and search follow it. Drag the line between the pages to resize them, double-click it to share evenly. Each pane has an × to close it, and ⌘K can turn the two or close one. In a narrow window only the active page shows.

entries.title: Docs opens the manual inside folia
entries.detail: About folia › Docs now shows the folia Field Manual in a window of folia's own, from the copy folia carries. It needs no claude.ai account and no internet, so anyone who has folia can read it. A link to the web in the manual opens in your browser.

entries.title: folia asks before a moved page replaces one of the same name
entries.detail: When you move or copy a page to a section that already has a page with its name, folia asks whether to replace it. Replace puts the page that was there into the trash, and undo brings it back. Cancel moves nothing. Dropping a page on a section in the sidebar asks too.

entries.title: A page title is no longer cut when you zoom
entries.detail: When you zoom a page in or out, its title grows or shrinks with it and wraps onto more lines when it needs them. Before, a zoomed title was cut off at the line below it.

entries.title: A click on a picture shows it at its own size
entries.detail: Click a picture in a page and it opens over the window at its own size. A picture larger than the window scrolls. Esc or a click closes it. The corners still resize the picture in the page.

entries.title: scripta's folia note finds a day's page in a person's notebook
entries.detail: A page titled with the day alone, as in a notebook kept for one person, is found by the notebook's name: scripta's folia note for "20261014 JF Anna" opens the page "20261014" in the notebook "JF Anna".

entries.title: scripta's folia note finds the meeting's page
entries.detail: scripta's folia note opens the meeting's page in folia: the page scripta wrote the minutes into, else the page prepared for the meeting, else the page of that day with the meeting's title. If there is none, folia says so. A meeting page you put in the trash stays there: scripta no longer makes a new one in its place.

entries.title: Move and copy pages to any section, in any notebook
entries.detail: A page's … menu has Move to section… and Copy to section…, also for several picked pages, and so has the bar at the foot of the page list. A window lists every notebook with its sections. Into another notebook, a page's pictures and files go along, so the people of that notebook can open them. A copy is a new page with the same title, text, pictures and files.

entries.title: Numbered sub-lists keep every item
entries.detail: A numbered sub-list whose first item is indented more than the next, as some pages from OneNote have it, lost that first item. Now it keeps every item. Copies from OneNote also keep a word that OneNote wrote bold or italic in two pieces. Settings › OneNote no longer has "Repair them": no page has a broken table any more.

entries.title: At login, folia stays in the background
entries.detail: Opened at login, folia now waits in the background instead of coming to the front. Started by you, it still comes to the front with its window.

entries.title: Table lines stay while you drag; the window comes up at a start
entries.detail: While you drag a column line, the table keeps all its lines instead of losing them until you let go. And started again, folia now comes to the front with its window, instead of opening it behind the app you were in.

entries.title: A moved column line shows at once
entries.detail: After you let go of a column line in a fitted table, the table is drawn anew at once, without moving the mouse away from the line first.

entries.title: Column lines of a fitted table move smoothly
entries.detail: In a table with Fit width on, dragging a line between two columns now moves only those two columns, and the table stays as wide as the page. A press on a line without moving it no longer makes the table jump.

entries.title: Tables fit the page, also with new columns
entries.detail: Fit width is now a switch above each table, and on by default: the table spans the page, its columns keep their proportions, and a new column takes its share instead of pushing the table past the page. Switched off, a table keeps the widths it shows and has its own from then on.

entries.title: Typing into a new heading works again
entries.detail: A heading you had just made, empty, took no letters on a page that is kept in sync. Now it does.

entries.title: No black window after an update
entries.detail: When folia's offline copy holds parts of two versions, folia now drops the copy once and loads afresh, instead of showing a black window. Pictures and files kept for offline use stay.

entries.title: A page to the top or bottom; the list scrolls while you drag
entries.detail: A page's … menu moves it to the top or the bottom of its section, or of its group. Dragged near the page list's top or bottom, the list scrolls by itself, faster the closer you come, and the dragged page shows half see-through. The bar at the list's foot also moves the open page alone.

entries.title: The Dock icon's menu holds the menu bar menu
entries.detail: A right click on folia's Dock icon shows the items of its menu bar icon: About, Settings…, Check for Updates…, Open folia and Open in Browser.

entries.title: The check of a copy reads a "*" right
entries.detail: A page with a "*" between two words or numbers, as in 123*4, is no longer listed as not good after the copy. Its text was right.

entries.title: A YouTube video from OneNote keeps its title
entries.detail: OneNote names an embedded video with a link. A copy from OneNote now puts that name on a line above the player, so it is no longer lost. The check of a copy also reads a path with "\" right.

entries.title: Every copy from OneNote checks itself
entries.detail: After Copy fresh from OneNote and each page of a repair, folia checks the page: every word of OneNote's page is there, every picture and file is stored, and none of the known faults shows. The message says what the check found, and Settings › OneNote lists the pages that need a look.

entries.title: Repair from OneNote has a clear name
entries.detail:
In Settings › OneNote, Broken tables is now Repair from OneNote. It says what it repairs: a table that fell apart into loose lines, or "
" shown as text.

entries.title: New versions arrive while folia stays open
entries.detail: folia looks for a new version each time it comes back into view, so the menu bar app does not keep an old one for days. In Settings, Done has the size and font of the other buttons.

entries.title: ⌘H hides folia again
entries.detail: ⌘H hides folia, ⌥⌘H hides the other apps. And every button and choice in Settings now has the same size, colours and type.

entries.title: The Mac app to download, also in the Mac app
entries.detail: Settings › Mac app in the Mac app also offers the newest folia for Mac to download, for another Mac.

entries.title: folia in the menu bar, with a hotkey
entries.detail: The Mac app has an icon in the menu bar, with Open folia and Open in Browser. ⌃⌥⌘F opens folia from any app, and hides it again. Settings › Mac app sets the hotkey, where folia shows its icon (menu bar, Dock, or both), and Open at login.

entries.title: Left pages leave the list once fixed
entries.detail: Settings › OneNote › Left as they are no longer lists a page once it is copied fresh from OneNote: it goes at once, not only at the next daily update.
